additional_info.body:
Hello Filomena, good afternoon.
I checked these 2 chargers and found that both of them went offline at the same exact time:
At 12pm UTC both chargers stopped receiving backend communication.
I checked the both routers and the connected is there:
There seems to be no data transfer, this indicates that something is wrong with the network and is not transmitting.
I already rebooted the routers and the problem is not solved so it seems to be upstream. Best I can do is restart the charger completely but I am suspecting that it won't work, since nobody did any change from the time it went offline.
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
